#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <utility>

using namespace std;

pair<int,int> analyze(const string& s) {
    int maxLen = 0;
    int currentRun = 0;
    int totalWords = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;
    bool maxInside = false;
    bool wordsInside = false;
    bool inWord = false;

    for (char ch : s) {
        if (ch == '(') {
            maxInside = true;
            wordsInside = true;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            maxInside = false;
            currentRun = 0;
            totalWords += insideWords;
            insideWords = 0;
            inWord = false;
            wordsInside = false;
        } else {
            if (!maxInside) {
                if (ch == '_') {
                    currentRun = 0;
                } else {
                    currentRun++;
                    if (currentRun > maxLen) {
                        maxLen = currentRun;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (wordsInside) {
                if (ch == '_') {
                    inWord = false;
                } else {
                    if (!inWord) {
                        insideWords++;
                    }
                    inWord = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return make_pair(maxLen, totalWords);
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    auto result = analyze(s);
    cout << result.first << " " << result.second << endl;
    return 0;
}
